# `passportsim wifi_ap`

Add, update, remove or list one scripted Wi-Fi access point.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Caps group | `radio` |
| MCP tool | `passport_wifi_ap` |
| HTTP route | `POST /v1/instances/{id}/commands/wifi_ap` |
| Scenario step | `wifi.ap` |
| CLI aliases | none |
| Annotations | `needs_instance` |

## Hosts

The matrix below is the full one; this page is byte-identical on every host.

| macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim wifi_ap [--auth <AUTH>] [--bssid <BSSID>] [--channel <CHANNEL>] [--instance <INSTANCE>] [--key <KEY>] [--remove] [--rssi <RSSI>] [--ssid <SSID>] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `auth` | `--auth <AUTH>` | `union` | no | - |
| `bssid` | `--bssid <BSSID>` | `string` | no | - |
| `channel` | `--channel <CHANNEL>` | `integer` | no | - |
| `instance` | `--instance <INSTANCE>` | `string` | no | Instance id. |
| `key` | `--key <KEY>` | `string` | no | Secret; never echoed. |
| `remove` | `--remove` | `boolean` | no | - |
| `rssi` | `--rssi <RSSI>` | `integer` | no | - |
| `ssid` | `--ssid <SSID>` | `string` | no | - |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

Input schema: [`docs/schema/commands/wifi_ap.input.json`](../schema/commands/wifi_ap.input.json).

## Examples

### Put an open access point on channel 6

```sh
passportsim wifi_ap --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "channel": 6,
  "rssi": -40,
  "ssid": "passport-emu-virtual-ap"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "channel": 6,
  "rssi": -40,
  "ssid": "passport-emu-virtual-ap"
}
'@ | passportsim wifi_ap --json -
```

### List the air

```sh
passportsim wifi_ap --json - <<'JSON'
{}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{}
'@ | passportsim wifi_ap --json -
```

### Take it off the air

```sh
passportsim wifi_ap --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "remove": true,
  "ssid": "passport-emu-virtual-ap"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "remove": true,
  "ssid": "passport-emu-virtual-ap"
}
'@ | passportsim wifi_ap --json -
```
